correctness.rationale: For k>=3, r>=2 the center deletion is a simplex and X is its homotopy cofiber of the link; the link faces (I,J) obey exactly 1+|I|+|I cap J|<=r. Fiberwise acyclic toggle of b_i for the least missing a_i cancels all non-full-inner fibers; toggling b_1 on I=[k] leaves precisely C(k-1,h) critical faces dimension r-2 for h=r-k-1 in [0,k-1], and none outside. One suspension yields the proposed contractibility and sphere-window formula. The S_k invariant subcomplex I neq [k] is contractible, and the relative chain groups with all a_i selected identify integrally as sign tensor wedge^j Z^k, differential contraction by augmentation; its top kernel is wedge^h U_k. For r=1, the join of k zero-spheres gives S^(k-1) with arm-sign action. Independent exact mod-two chain ranks checked every r for k=3 and 4, and source verifier additionally checks acyclicity and signed characters for k<=5; finite tests do not prove all k.
